name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.0 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 6 visits over 41 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 36 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 41 hours starting 2025-12-16, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.78 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
